understood_as: Approved implementation, tests, GPU smoke and exact checkpoint restoration only. Long training requires a subsequent user approval; no production queue is authorized.
question: Does actor or teacher access to absolute time limit exploit extrapolation when the previous action outcome can be observed?
architecture: All conditions use separate actor and critic CNN32/shared-dense512 encoders; actor2 and critic4 hidden layers of512. Current and previous maps concatenate as channels. Numeric input concatenates current13, previous13, previous-action one-hot23, history-valid1. Current commanded goal is appended separately. Teacher retains CNN16/four512 Q layers and input BatchRenorm, using the same history input. No parameter sharing between actor and critic. No recurrence.
mask: Set current and previous remaining_world_fraction to zero before encoding or normalization, only for the designated actor/teacher. Critic keeps both actual time coordinates in every condition. Masks do not alter dimensions, parameter counts, optimizer or initialization keys.
history: One previous real pre-action environmental observation and actually selected/executed action, plus a common history-valid marker. Zero previous maps/numeric/action with valid=false at every world reset, including first control after forced waits. Goal switches within a world do not reset history. Forced waits and inactive post-delivery padding do not enter history. No variant, blockage or success flag is added. Consecutive identical blocked attempts may again produce identical history inputs; this is not long memory.
alignment: Store the selected action ID on valid agent-controlled transitions: a blocked dash is still a dash, not NOOP. Invalid padding is excluded; forced waits never call the learner outcome. World reset takes precedence over a simultaneously valid final action. Packed inputs for collection, stored PPO/teacher minibatches and evaluation share pack_inputs; final bootstrap uses successor observation and successor history. Teacher receives packed environmental features but no commanded-goal input, retaining its original all-goal heads.

input_schema.source: src/hackrl/spatial_wall_pass.py: MODEL_FEATURE_NAMES and MAP_CHANNEL_NAMES; maps are current channels followed by previous channels

restore_contract: Restore actor/critic/teacher weights, Adam states, teacher BatchRenorm buffers, environment, command state, world/delay/action/goal RNGs, one-step history, exposure counters and update counters. Subsequent normal and delayed-adaptation full updates must match uninterrupted trees and metrics exactly. Frozen evaluation uses a separate environment/history/RNG and must leave the serialized full training state unchanged.
bc: Coefficient0.1 at global update0, linear to0 at global4608. Adaptation begins at512, without schedule restart; last applied update uses index4607.
learning: Original normal12 fixed pretraining, delivery q=.1 random-delay adaptation; same PPO and teacher updates, rewards, terminal masks, global BC schedule0..4608. Existing current-observation A is historical only; all four new conditions start fresh.
evaluation: Natural mode primary, sample8 secondary,16 layouts, delays0 /1..8 /10,12; fixed/mutant/one-shot-block kernels. Full state immutable. Report mutant success/wall-pass/control length jointly with fixed success/return; failure seeds retained. Known10/12 follow-up points, not a new holdout;16 layouts are fixture transforms, not new-map generalization.

validation.contract: Per condition: one normal update, one normal continuation and its disk-restored repeat, one adaptation update and its disk-restored repeat, followed by the full frozen evaluation matrix. Full512x64 shape; disposable normal states placed at a world-reset boundary/global512 for adaptation execution smoke only, not pretrained science checkpoints. No performance gate from these smokes.
